Java get nth element of arraylist

To get the nth element of an ArrayList in Java, you can simply call the `get()` method on the ArrayList and pass the index you want to retrieve as the parameter. Here's an example:
```java
ArrayList<String> list = new ArrayList<String>();
list.add("apple");
list.add("banana");
list.add("cherry");

String thirdElement = list.get(2); // get the third element, which has index 2
```
